title: CrossScore OOD-KD controlled code and round-two component evidence
description: Source and derived numerical evidence for the Scientific Reports revision on the limits of MSP-derived supervision for Energy OOD detection. Complete C/E/R factorial, norm-matched follow-up, frozen protocols and independent numerical checks. See README for external data, checkpoint and reproduction limitations.
notes: This release adds the completed matched-temperature C/E/R factorial and P2-C1 norm-matched follow-up. Five-seed and three-seed estimates are exploratory and use previously examined OOD domains. CPU summary reproduction is distinct from new training and from re-evaluation of raw per-image arrays. The creator follows the existing software record; manuscript authorship is stated separately in the paper.
